description: CI gates (literals scan + mypy) and README update. Independent of all other FEATs — pure config and docs changes.
steps: 1. MODIFY .github/workflows/pipeline.yaml: add job 'literals-scan' under Stage 1 as a peer of python-lint-test (no needs: dependency). Steps: checkout@v4, then a bash step that iterates over the 9 literal patterns (RECYC-DELHI-01, PLANT-OKHLA-2, EWB-2026-99210, COMP-IN-001, ORG-DEV-001, CPCB_ACCEPTED, DISPATCH_FALLBACK, historical_debt_default_tons.*3600, FY2026-27) using grep -rn --include='*.py' against api/src and worker/src; exits 1 if any match found. Add 'literals-scan' to the needs: list of the build-and-push job.

2. MODIFY .github/workflows/pipeline.yaml: add job 'type-check' under Stage 1 as a peer of python-lint-test (no needs: dependency). Steps: checkout@v4, setup-python@v5 with python-version 3.13, pip install mypy types-python-slugify, pip install -e api, then run `cd api && python -m mypy src/ --ignore-missing-imports --no-strict-optional 2>&1 | tail -5`. Add 'type-check' to the needs: list of the build-and-push job.

3. READ README.md fully before modifying. MODIFY README.md: (a) Insert ## Current Status section immediately after the title and tagline paragraph listing all 7 phases (P0 through P6) and their status. (b) In ## Quick Start add step '1b. Run database migrations' after step 1: `cd packages/synthetiq-shared && alembic upgrade head`. (c) Add a prerequisites box/block listing SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD, JWT_SECRET_KEY, CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS as mandatory env vars. (d) Add note that REFACTORING_SUMMARY.md and ANALYSIS_FINDINGS.md are archived (files don't exist; note only). Do NOT rewrite existing Quick Start content — insert additions only.

4. CHECK for existence of REFACTORING_SUMMARY.md and ANALYSIS_FINDINGS.md at repo root c:\Users\HP\SynthetIQ\. If they exist (they do NOT per exploration), prepend ARCHIVED header. Since they do not exist, skip this step.
acceptance_criteria: .github/workflows/pipeline.yaml is valid YAML (helm lint or yamllint passes)
